name: Haso
title: Descendant mentioned in the genealogies
summary: Haso is a person mentioned in the biblical genealogies in connection with the return from the Babylonian exile. He is known as the father of some who returned to Judah, and his name appears in the book of Nehemiah among those who sealed the covenant.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned in the genealogies
keyEvents.description: Haso is mentioned in connection with the Levitical genealogies and the lists of those who returned from exile to Jerusalem.

keyEvents.title: Renewal of the Covenant under Nehemiah
keyEvents.description: In the time after the return from Babylon, the people participated in a renewal of the covenant with God, during which families and clans were registered.

keyEvents.title: Rebuilding of Jerusalem
keyEvents.description: Haso lived during the time when the walls of Jerusalem were rebuilt under the leadership of Nehemiah, a period of spiritual and national renewal for the people of Israel.

keyEvents.title: Levitical Service Restored
keyEvents.description: After the return, the Levitical service in the temple was restored, and the genealogies were important to confirm who had the right to serve.
